verdict.rationale: MailerLite has developer API docs, official SDKs and an llms.txt index. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference, a try-it console or runnable examples, and every OpenAPI spec path probed returned 404. API documentation alone does not show the interactive, runnable capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
